East Carolina University Graduate School Application Information
Application Requirements
• Nonrefundable $75 application fee
• Official Transcripts from all schools attended
Note: Programs may have specific application requirements. Please review the Find Your Program
page for more information.
Graduate School Application Open Dates
TERM DATE
Spring July 1
1st Summer August 15
11-week Summer August 15
2nd Summer August 15
Fall August 15
Some programs have specialized dates for application availability. Please see below for a list of
programs and links to application date information.
Occupational Therapy – OTCAS Application Dates
Physical Therapy – PTCAS Application Dates
Physician Assistant Studies – CASPA Application Dates
Public Health – SOPHAS Application Dates
Nursing – Nursing program open dates vary by concentration. Please contact the Office of Graduate
Admissions for more information.
Application Deadlines
For application deadline information, visit the Find Your Program page. Be sure to pay close attention
to the deadline definitions.
For additional questions, contact us a gradschool@ecu.edu.
